title: Lightly Laced Portuguese Vermicelli Rice Noodles Bowl
description: A pungent, crispy, and cozy Portuguese dish featuring vermicelli rice noodles, a bain-marie, and lacto-vegetarian-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a comfort meal on a weeknight.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the Portuguese spice blend, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the vermicelli rice noodles to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add 250ml of water to the saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the noodles are tender.
While the noodles are cooking, heat a separate saucepan of water over high heat and blanch the cherry tomatoes for 1-2 minutes.
Drain the cherry tomatoes and set aside.
Once the noodles are cooked, stir in the blanched cherry tomatoes.
Serve the vermicelli rice noodles hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and lemon wedges if desired.
